resources.string: A map that grows with you.
Fog hides unexplored places. Enter a new %1$s square to reveal it. Driving marks roads in blue and records distance.
Two more squares revealed. This preview does not save progress.
Allow Precise location to record roads. Automatic tracking is the default; switch to manual tracking in Settings if you prefer.\n\nSet up while parked. Stop tracking from the notification.
Open Layers → Explore nearby to see visited tiles around you. You can also highlight towns, states or regions, and countries.\n\nTap the location button to recenter the map.
Trips saves drives and replays. Badges shows achievements, Goals has weekly challenges, and Forum has community tips.\n\nWalking uncovers tiles; driving earns road and distance credit.
Earn points from new roads, achievements and first visits to places. Spend them in Garage on cars, colors and other cosmetics.

Use Settings to customize the map, tracking, notifications and backups. Account controls are under Account & community.\n\nReplay this tour from Settings → Help & about → Quick tour. An account is optional; setup follows the tour if needed.
Review the map and tracking controls.
Ask before leaving the map with Back.
Leaving keeps your saved progress. Tracking can continue in the background, subject to Android’s location and battery settings. To stop recording, use Stop tracking in the notification.
Your progress is saved. Tracking is off.
